metadata.description: Distributed-systems, messaging, and integration patterns skill for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: distributed-systems-patterns
plugins.description: Apply distributed-systems, messaging, and integration patterns to architectural decisions, message contracts, and operational artifacts for event-driven, microservice, queue, broker, saga, outbox, CDC, workflow, scaling, resilience, and multi-region work. Default outputs are decisions and contracts, not implementation code; specific libraries are user choices. Includes 12 slash commands: /build orchestrates the per-feature pipeline end-to-end with approval gates; granular commands /design, /contract, /implement, /test, /architecture, /standard, /runbook, /review, /failure-mode, /readiness, /prelaunch run individually. Plus 27 reference files.
